objective: Reejecutar de forma idempotente en EDARSAHUB Development la migracion versionada de enriquecimiento de tickets cerrados para vendedor_id, vendedor_nombre y descuento_pct, con preflight y post-audit READ_ONLY. No tocar Produccion.

queries.name: pre_schema_ticket_closed_enrichment
queries.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND TABLE_NAME='Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto' AND COLUMN_NAME IN ('vendedor_id','vendedor_nombre','descuento_pct') ORDER BY COLUMN_NAME

queries.name: pre_index_ticket_closed
queries.sql: SELECT i.name,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto') AND i.name='UX_Comercial_Intel_VentasDetalle_NoDup' ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: post_schema_ticket_closed_enrichment
queries.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND TABLE_NAME='Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto' AND COLUMN_NAME IN ('vendedor_id','vendedor_nombre','descuento_pct') ORDER BY COLUMN_NAME

queries.name: post_index_ticket_closed
queries.sql: SELECT i.name,i.is_unique,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto') AND i.name='UX_Comercial_Intel_VentasDetalle_NoDup' ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal
